Early engagement on the post itself was low (32 impressions, 0 likes at scan); figures are from that account, not an exchange primary source.

news.headline: Green Morning memecoin cited near $7.1M after Elon–CZ exchange
news.detail: @Codedscientist (2,929 followers) posted at 10:34 Berlin that after Elon trolled CZ again, a memecoin framed as green-morning:native (Green Morning) was already near a $7.1M market cap. No contract address in the post; early engagement low (16 impressions, 1 like). Distinct from the many thin Red Morning ($RM) launches tracked earlier today.

news.headline: The Fallen Hero (BSC) hit ~5.1x about an hour after the launch note
news.detail: Signal account @bitecong (38,530 followers) posted a 1-hour update quoting its earlier launch note: CA 0xe451b966aa64bee4046cfcb0db5fe6aa9f647777. It says the token peaked at about 5.1x (~55 minutes after the note) and was trading around 4.1x at update time, with market cap cited as up from $35.4K at the note to $360.1K, and 511 buys vs 448 sells in the window described.

news.headline: X News: World Liberty Financial launches WLFI token buyback program
news.detail: X news summary: World Liberty Financial announced a buyback plan for its $WLFI governance token, potentially funded by fees from its $USD1 stablecoin reserves, aiming to strengthen the ecosystem and boost long-term holder voting power. Timing follows a ~10% WLFI drop since recent U.S. midterms and a larger year-to-date decline; amounts and schedule still early-stage.

news.headline: White Claw ($WCLAW) team says it is shutting down after eight months
news.detail: Official account @wclawonsol (446 followers) posted at 07:01 Berlin a 'Final Message to the White Claw Community' saying after eight months of building and promoting they are officially closing WCLAW on Solana. Very low engagement so far (1–2 impressions); treat as a self-announced project wind-down, not a confirmed on-chain rug.

news.headline: swap.io weekly: Solana's share of memecoin trading volume hit 86% in October
news.detail: @swapdotio (6,004 followers) posted its Solana Weekly Update at 07:00 Berlin citing Q3 records ($17.51B stablecoin market cap, $197B spot DEX volume, app revenue near $300M) and saying Solana's share of memecoin trading volume climbed to 86% in October, highest since April. Early engagement: 42 impressions, 1 like, 1 repost at scan time.

news.headline: X News: David Dobrik partners with FOMO app, pitches it as stock trading while it is memecoin-focused
news.detail: X news summary: David Dobrik promoted FOMO as an app to buy and sell stocks; critics say the app is for trading memecoins on chains like Solana (copy-trading, ~0.5% fees) and call the stocks label misleading for mainstream fans. Supporters see it as a way to reach his audience without crypto jargon.

news.headline: X News: Trump Media transfers 4,259 BTC (~$343M) to Crypto.com amid Nov 30 debt deadline
news.detail: X news summary: blockchain trackers saw Trump Media move over 4,000 Bitcoin (about $343M) to Crypto.com in two batches this week from wallets labeled as collateral for 2028 convertible notes, emptying most of those addresses ahead of a Nov 30 holder cash-repayment option on ~$1B notes. No sales confirmed; firm still holds roughly 14,139 BTC total. Chatter ties timing to post-midterm stock drops.

news.headline: X News: Trader Ansem turns SOL short loss into profit via Pump.fun callout rewards
news.detail: X news summary: Ansem closed a $1.7M SOL short earlier with a ~$10.8K loss, then shorted ~$1M more on Pump.fun and took about $35K in callout rewards even while the short sat ~$60K underwater. The story frames Pump.fun callout USDC payouts as able to outpace direct trade P&L for top callers.

news.headline: X News: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev posts 'The trenches are calling and I must go'
news.detail: X news summary: On 5 Nov Tenev's short trenches post became a meme rallying traders around memecoins and tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain (Ethereum L2 live since 1 Jul 2026), with quotes hyping 'RH szn round 2'.

news.headline: X News: Solana Labs launches Leap mobile app for tokenized stocks, ETFs, and crypto
news.detail: X news summary: Leap early access hit iOS TestFlight on 5 Nov (Android soon), built by the Dialect team Solana Labs acquired. Self-custodial swaps via Jupiter, chart news, fee-inclusive P&L; aims beyond memecoins; tokenized stocks restricted in US/UK/EEA; future fees may burn SOL.
